text: Hardware shop had already locked up so we went to Coles instead.
Priya strapped her new watch on and showed everyone at the cafe.
We walked arm in arm to the bakery the way she likes.
Fridge door seal is broken again, told his mum so she can ring the landlord.
Held the ladder while Tom changed the globe in the hallway.
Tom asked me to hang on to his wallet at the footy so he wouldn't lose it again.
Walked to the letterbox with her frame, hip protectors on as usual.
Jake did his own seatbelt and picked the music on the drive home.
Prompted Priya with her usual tablets after tea, signed the med chart.
Mrs B wanted a nap so I pulled the curtains and left her bedroom door open.
She wants the front door locked at night cos she's scared of break-ins, so I locked it on my way out like she asked. She has her own key on the hook.
Helped Jake strap his knee brace on for basketball like the physio showed us.
Jake asked for his weighted blanket for his rest after lunch and took it off himself when he got up.
Tom said he'd rather stay in and watch the cricket than go to the gym, so we stayed in.
Mrs B dozed off in her chair after lunch so I popped a blanket over her.
Gave Jake his usual night meds at 8 off the chart.
Priya didn't want her shower so we left it and tried again after tea, she was fine then.
Bus driver told Tom off for being loud, he went quiet and sat up the back by himself. We talked it through after.
Jake wanted the bathroom door locked while he showered for privacy, he unlocked it himself after.
Priya wanted to sit in the car on her own for a bit after the shops, door open, I waited on the bench nearby.
Jake kicked off after lunch so I sat against his bedroom door from the hallway till he'd quietened down, maybe 15 mins.
Tom was swearing at everyone so I made him stay in the garage on his own and kept the roller door down till he said sorry.
Mrs B kept wandering into the kitchen so I left her out on the back verandah with the screen door latched for an hour, she was banging on it a bit.
Priya was screaming so I put her out in the back courtyard by herself and held the sliding door closed till she stopped. She scraped her knuckles on the flyscreen.
Gave him the extra half tablet so he'd settle before tea.
Tom was really wound up so I gave him a couple of his mum's anxiety pills, he slept most of the arvo.
Mixed one of her sleeping pills into her custard at lunch so she'd have a nap and stop calling out.
Jake wouldn't sit still at the dentist so I gave him two of his hayfever tablets so he'd be dopey. He was wobbly on the stairs after and fell, grazed his elbow.
Did the strap up on her recliner so she'd stop getting up and wandering, she had a red mark on her tummy from it later.
Left the brakes on Jake's chair and parked him by the window so he'd stop following me round the kitchen.
Knotted Tom's jumper sleeves behind the chair so he'd stay sitting down for tea.
Put Priya's onesie on back to front at bedtime so she can't get at the zip and undress overnight.
Tom wouldn't give the remote back so I wrapped both arms round him on the couch and kept him there till he let go of it.
Jake went for his brother so I got him onto the lounge room floor and lay across his back until he settled.
She kept trying to pull her stockings off so I leant on her knees to keep her legs still while I got them back on.
Priya kept trying to get out of the shower so I held her there by the shoulders till I'd finished her hair, she's got a few red marks on her arm tonight.
Put the padlock back on the fridge so he can't graze between meals.
Kept the back door keyed so she couldn't wander while I hung the washing out.
Tom's not allowed in the shed with his drum kit till he's paid his mum back, I kept the key on me.
Priya's not allowed to the Friday disco this week because of how she spoke to her mum, I rang and cancelled her spot.
Gave Priya her as-needed lorazepam 0.5mg at 6.30, distress score was 5 so as per her plan, settled by 7.
Put the sides up on Nonna's bed before I left tonight, as per her plan for falls.
